human_time_assumption.meaning: Hypothetical triage-time weighting, not observed business cost or measured time saved. Both supported findings and supported proposals receive the 5-minute rejection weight. Unknown/error items are counted separately and remain unpriced.

classification_note: Operational error-direction buckets, not verified causal diagnoses. Every wrong item is included; a case can occur in more than one category.
dataset_revision: V1 results preserved but excluded from final deltas. V2 extends W4-07/30/38 evidence bounds and tightens W4-10/16/21/29 wording; labels unchanged. Evaluation-authored titles removed from model source provenance.
limitations: Exact quality metrics are agreement with AI-proposed labels pending human review, not human accuracy.
One real model call per case per stage; no repeat-run uncertainty estimate. Serving nondeterminism remains possible.
Cumulative prompt development used the same development set; incremental deltas do not isolate causal effects.
The first three hypotheses were registered from the v1 baseline before the corrected v2 runs; the calibration hypothesis was registered after authority and before its own run.
Component-only evaluation: no full-investigator or observed business-outcome measurement.
Dollar cost remains unknown without provider rates; hypothetical minute weights are not observed cost or time saved.
Human label review and an independently labeled held-out set are required before promotion/generalization claims.
